 October 27, 2026 by Richard Pagliaro 
 Photo credit: Rob Stone/@RobStoneTennis 
 Swiss Indoors Basel 
Basel, Switzerland
October 26-November 1, 2026 
Surface: Hard Court
Prize Money: €2,584,155 
 Taylor Fritz, Ben Shelton, Rafael Jodar, Novak Djokovic Headline Basel Field 
US Open finalist Ben Shelton is top seed and Arthur Fils is seeded second in Basel. Novak Djokovic and Stan Wawrinka have each received wild cards into the main draw. Roger Federer, who once served as a ball boy at the Swiss Indoors Basel, fittingly is the most successful player in the event’s history, winning 10 titles at his hometown tournament. Switzerland’s leading sport event boasts an impressive list of former champions, including tennis Hall of Famers Bjorn Borg, Ivan Lendl, John McEnroe, Boris Becker, Stefan Edberg and Pete Sampras.
